fusions.name: Hoofbeat Lash
fusions.desc: A quick lash that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Tireless Circuit
fusions.desc: Whips strands round you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Unflagging Tow
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3s after you use it.

fusions.name: Tethered Mount
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. You can ride it.
